name: Sell and edit orders by unit
description: Staff and buyers can price and sell the same product by piece, box, case or pallet, with the right price at each level.
notes: Pricing ladder, product-unit editor, and order/invoice unit-aware writes are merged. Choosing a unit on create-order (#1147) and staff edit-by-unit (#1148) are both merged, closing part of the sell/edit-by-unit surface. Local seed now grants flag.units_v1 on the test tenant (#1223). Mobile unit labels (step 8) and switching the feature on for real tenants are cut to follow-up -- see D-04 and D-19. Real-tenant activation is still gated on the B641-B680 money-integrity family (F-07) closing. A second remembered-price consumer (scan-screen PriceEditor) still lacks #1147's B606 unit guard -- see D-29 (B684). CLARIFIED 2026-09-23: the owner's reported defect that a price can't be set per unit is not a build gap. Master already has the web 'Units & prices' card on the product page (create/edit/delete unit levels with all five tier prices) and the order-line unit picker, and the order-edit request already accepts a unit label -- all of it simply hidden behind flag.units_v1, which is off for every real tenant. B738 and B739, filed from a stale tree, are being moved to cleared; B737 is re-scoped as closed once the flag is on. What's actually left: the mobile unit picker (#1264) is superseded locally by an unpushed v2 (sha c2caf627) -- the architect's pre-read verified the extraction and the money commit but requires the order-total helper to be lifted into a tested pure module before it lands; B747 (resuming a parked mobile cart with a unit line is refused) needs its own fix right after v2; and the standing safety conditions -- the F-07 money-integrity family closing, plus the architect's open units findings -- have to clear before the owner can decide to flip the flag for their own tenant.

name: Purchase orders: edit, receive, raise from a scanned bill
description: Turns a paper or PDF supplier bill into a trackable purchase order with an accurate cost, instead of manual data entry.
notes: PO API, edit (all 3 parts) and PO-from-scan are merged. Exact PO totals from the entered case cost (B677, #1199) merged, UI proof still owed post-merge (PROOF-REQ #938). Edit-PO modal (#1210, supersedes closed #1165) and raise-from-scan (#1045) are both merged; raise-from-scan also has no Playwright proof yet of the 3k-line scan modal (PROOF-REQ #938). Mobile PO list (step 8) deferred, see D-05. PO receipt costing 'lot carries its total cost' end state deferred, see D-11. Unbound CreatePurchaseOrderDto on the create endpoint deferred, see D-12. NEW 2026-09-23: B743 filed (high, live) -- a scanned vendor-bill line with no stated pack size is posted as pieces, so stock under-counts and cost over-states. Fix ships as four small PRs in order: an API gate shipped dark with a would-deny log first (committed locally at 1effe968, awaiting architect review), then the web scan modal (must never auto-acknowledge an unstated pack size), then mobile, then the enforcement flip once the owner has reviewed the would-deny log. B746 filed (high): historic receipts already posted this way need a read-only sizing report (the owner runs it) followed by a count-based repair, not an automatic rewrite. The supplier unit-of-measure learning design is settled -- remember the pack size per supplier and item, re-check the arithmetic on every receipt, ask the operator only once; it reuses the existing but currently-unused SupplierProduct table. That work starts after B743 closes.

name: Scanner redesign
description: Scan barcodes with the camera to build an order or receive stock, faster than typing SKUs by hand.
notes: Camera, scan engine and scan screen merged. Tap-to-edit price sheet merged (#1213, supersedes closed #1119) — its PriceEditor is a second remembered-price consumer that still lacks the B606 unit-label guard, see D-29 (B684). Poor-signal queue (#1120, B595) is still open, not yet merged.

name: New order screen
description: A cleaner, faster order entry and order detail screen on web and mobile, with spreadsheet-style line entry.
notes: Steps 3, 8, 9, 10 merged. Mobile order line cards (step 11, #1204) merged. Boxed delivery progress in boxes+pieces (B597, #1121) and a cancelled line showing no progress (B669, #1189) are in proof stage, captured in the same Playwright run. Mobile order status-change errors now reach the app's error modal (#1089), passed review with only low-severity notes. UPDATE 2026-09-23: multi-line per-item notes (#1261) is merged and live on web in production. #1267 (B742) is a test-only fix for a 50ms scanner-refocus race that failed the notes test on fast machines -- it has the architect's PASS and lands tonight. A related but separate bug, B744, was filed: the same delayed refocus steals focus at 8 sites across 4 screens, so scanning while typing a note can submit half-typed search text on the next Enter and pop open a phantom create-product dialog. The mobile-web horizontal-drift fix is written and verified at 390, 768 and 1440px by the Order UI lane, and is committed as small per-concern commits, awaiting screenshots. Two new overflow bugs were found at 390px only -- the customers-list toolbar and the invoices-list table -- and are being filed as B749 and B750.

name: Category labels and jurisdiction selling rules
description: Lets a tenant mark products with categories (for example flavored tobacco) and automatically block selling them where it's illegal, per customer.
notes: Steps 1-6 (service, choke point, address normalization, category API/UI, restrictions admin + buyer catalog, tenant settings + mobile) merged; all 9 sell paths wired to the guard. Lift-rule dialog merged (#1200, supersedes closed #1143); its hardcoded reason-length message and uncapped textarea are now fixed too (#1215). One review follow-up remains open — the exact 'refine your search' empty-state wording, see D-06. The RC proof for this feature only exercises the rules-lift flow if the one-line admin mint lands, see D-03.

name: Backoffice usability and entitlement protection
description: Lets the platform team preview a plan change before confirming it, keeps a tenant's feature entitlements intact across a downgrade and re-upgrade, and fixes accessibility issues in the admin screens.
notes: A1 tier-change preview and A2 core (entitlement config survives downgrade) merged. A2 tail (live restore switch + audit report, #1059/#1060) fixing, see D-08. A3 backoffice audit fixes (badge contrast, modal focus, alert wording, B678, #1194) passed with low-severity notes, see D-07. A3 40px tap targets (#1114) not on the critical path -- moved off the shared globals.css stylesheet per the ruling so it doesn't trip the marketing-site file-integrity check.

name: Money integrity for boxed units
description: Fixes a family of bugs where selling, returning, or invoicing a product in boxes or cases could book the wrong charge, tax, or inventory count.
ownerLane: Senior Architect + Lead's builder + Lane B/F/S-scan + MacBook
notes: Release gate: units of measure stays off for real tenants until this closes (B661 is the one fix every other row leans on). Sub-bugs: B641, B645, B646, B647, B648, B649, B650, B651, B652, B653, B655, B656, B657, B658, B659, B660, B661, B662, B663, B664, B665, B667, B670, B671, B672, B673, B674, B677, B679, B680. B661's core fix (writeSaleEntries unit-basis conversion, #1207) and B647/B658 (standing orders, #1208) are merged. That fix itself desynced two downstream consumers of unitBasisQty in production; both are now fixed and confirmed green: return reversals (#1221 — a fully-returned box-unaware sale was reversing only ~8% of itself) and credit-note reversals (#1219 — full credits left ~55 phantom pieces per line on the filing). A third instance, in the TX Comptroller report, is deliberately NOT fixed: the pre/post-B661 ledger eras share no reliable discriminator, so it's filed as B681 and deferred rather than risk misclassifying a row's era — see D-33 (writeup on issue #938). Weekend batch (B638, B641, B644, B645, B655, B657 part 1, B666, B672), the legacy boxed-line classifier (#1202), and B672 follow-up scanner audit (#1193) are merged. B663 (short/on-account delivery) has a red test ready but no PR yet. Still open: #1184 (ledger correction columns/parked tables, B660/B662), #1217/#1218 (B665 operator restock resolution, merging imminently), #1185 (B667 partial-invoice cancel), #1121 (B597 web delivery progress), #1183 (B646 recurring-invoice line), #1197 (B673 rollover). Remaining B648-B651/B670/B674 sweep deferred, see D-13; B679 sweep deferred, see D-09; B680 (duplicate() writes no ledger rows) deferred, see D-10. Six more fast-follow bugs found during tonight's sweep (B682-B687: dead ambiguity guard, misleading comments, a second unguarded PriceEditor, no CI on DB-lane specs, seed.ts outside typecheck, no test for return+credit-note composing) are filed and deferred, see D-27 through D-32. UPDATE 2026-09-23: B717 (critical, a partial-box overcharge) is fixed in #1253 and deployed, with production exposure measured at ZERO. #1257 (SA-078b, the fourth rebuild caller) is merged and deployed. B736, a coverage-guard spec, is in progress. The #1246 ledger-correction script is being hardened locally.

name: Release 1 ship gate
description: The internal steps that take Release 1 from code-complete to live in production: a bug fix-or-defer call, one release-candidate proof, backup, migration, deploy, and a post-deploy health check.
ownerLane: Lead + Senior Architect + Mac Lead/F2 + Coordinator
notes: Fix-or-defer list for every open critical/high bug (one recommendation per bug); release-candidate proof on the Mac mini (owner login ~13:00Z, F2 drives 6 flows across three viewports); ship = backup, prod migration, merge train, deploy, post-deploy check. Go/no-go at 9:00am CDT (14:00Z) Tue 22 Sep. Release notes for customers ('what's new in Release 1') written once the merged list is final. Per-PR UI proofs were consolidated into one RC proof and backoffice pages dropped from it -- see D-01, D-02. OWNER RULING (late 2026-09-22): Release 1 is HELD OPEN until the units-of-measure work (F-01) is ready to ship -- the release will not go out without it. Production is currently still on #1261 (commit cb88378f, confirmed via the prod /health endpoint); the next deploy, #1262, failed at 00:41Z. Root cause is B745: the Dockerfile never copied the new packages/returns workspace, and packages/types was also missing. The B745 fix is proven and lands with #1267 in tonight's window.

name: Fleet operations and infrastructure hygiene
description: Internal engineering-fleet upkeep: freeing disk space, restoring an accidentally deleted folder, keeping the project tracker in sync, and closing out held tooling PRs.
notes: PC disk space freed from ~6GB to 3.3GB free; owner OK still wanted to clear node_modules from merged, idle worktrees. 2,814 tracked files restored after an agent's bad node_modules symlink deleted them; lane worktrees were unaffected. Merge-commit bug-register reformatting stopped (#1198, merged). MacBook idle, on regulated/returns rework until told to go. After-release tooling PRs (#1154, #1134, #1137) and the T6 tenantId NOT NULL final step and the Plane nightly-sync setup are intentionally held past Release 1 -- see D-16, D-17, D-15. UPDATE 2026-09-23: the Mac mini's disk filled and was recovered to 16GB free; its Docker VM went read-only as a result and was restarted by the owner; the stack came back intact and a Docker cleanup took the mini to 95GB free. Mini worktree cleanup removed 6 and kept 18. B748 filed: the janitor's merged-detection is wrong in both directions (false positives and false negatives). The window-close gate-guard tooling is built locally (sha 456a72028); full verify is still pending. All skills were switched from Opus 5 to Opus 5.5 by owner directive.

name: Tenants send email from their own mailbox
description: A tenant's outgoing customer emails (invoices, notifications) come from their own Gmail or Outlook address instead of a generic RouteFlow address.
notes: The send-from-own-mailbox code is merged (#824, #841). A test plan is written (local-assets/handoff/2026-09-22/email-test-plan.md) with console steps, an end-to-end script against the test tenant, and 6 named code risks -- the most serious: if a tenant revokes mailbox access, sending goes dark with no audit row or alert. Owner's console steps are the next move. A dedicated automated end-to-end test is deferred, see D-14.

name: Tenant onboarding runbook
description: A written, repeatable process for bringing a new paying customer onto RouteFlow, now built as an in-app wholesaler onboarding flow.
notes: Draft runbook written (local-assets/handoff/2026-09-22/tenant-onboarding-runbook.md; R1.1 scope). Superseded/extended by #2159 (epic: in-app wholesaler onboarding build, S1-S5), spec docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-24-wholesaler-onboarding-build.md, after B857-B859. SA-443 (2026-09-27) ruled the slice order and tiers: S1 cases + gated checklist + demo-bookings list (schema, tier 2 -- PR ready #2425 97617ab2, one additive migration 20260927060000_onboarding_s1_cases, owner runs it); S2 secure intake link; S3a apply-from-intake (HIGH tenancy, via SA); S3b setup fee (HIGH money, via SA); S4 tenant Getting-started; S5 reminders/purge/metrics. No client names in the record per house rule.

name: Lite plan readiness
description: Prepares a cut-down, lower-priced plan for basic customers: fixes its one known bug, proves it end-to-end, and writes the pricing page.
notes: Was frozen after an earlier plan-flag-enforcement incident caused a 27-hour outage; the owner's 9-21 'features first' ruling reopens it after Release 1 ships. Includes: unfreeze + PR-0 decision (retire the dark-flag safety lists, see D-18), the locked-page flash/stacked-toast fix (B449), proving Lite on the qa-lite test tenant (e2e specs 47+48 at three widths), and the plan page + pricing copy.

name: Onboard the first Lite customers
description: Brings 2-3 real basic customers onto the new Lite plan.
notes: Owner picks the customers; onboarding follows the F-11 runbook.

name: Refresh the sales demo tenant
description: Updates the standing sales-demo tenant so demos show the new units-of-measure and purchase-order work.
notes: Reseed the demo tenant (fictional customers/orders only) with Release 1 features.

name: CRM phase 1
description: Leads, pipeline, timeline, tasks, and converting a lead into a customer -- built fresh in RouteFlow's own design system.
notes: Blocked on the owner's three answers: who owns a reassigned lead; how loud the upgrade-now prompt should be at a plan limit; the allowed list of call outcomes. A clean-room rebuild, not a copy of the AGPL-licensed reference tool.

name: GoHighLevel lead handoff add-on
description: Publishes the price for the already-built lead-handoff integration.
notes: Integration is built and live, switched off by default; the $9.99/mo price needs publishing to the billing catalog.

name: Delivery notifications and a tracking link
description: Sends the customer an SMS or email when their delivery status changes, with a link to track it.
notes: Top competitive gap and the owner's #1 backlog item. The rules engine that triggers these already exists; sending the message is still a stub.

name: QuickBooks Online sync
description: Keeps RouteFlow's books in sync with QuickBooks Online automatically.
notes: CSV export only today; no live sync.

name: Guided mobile picking
description: Walks a warehouse picker through an order on their phone, step by step.
notes: The pick screen in the mobile app is currently a placeholder. Scope it the week of 28 Sep.

name: Multi-warehouse and transfers
description: Supports more than one stock location and moving inventory between them.
notes: No concept of more than one stock location yet -- this window is scoping only, not a build.

name: MSA filings and purchase-time excise tax
description: Produces the manufacturer-format filing distributors must send, and computes excise tax at time of purchase instead of time of sale.
notes: The regulated-products tax system is deep but doesn't yet produce this filing format. This window is scoping only.

name: Tracking engine: registers, gates and auto-published views
description: Keeps the roadmap registers self-updating: a validate gate, commit trailers, and scheduled renders that publish to Plane and brief every new session.
notes: Registers in the repo are the single source of truth; a validate gate in verify refuses inconsistent registers; commit/PR trailers (Feature:/Bug:/Defers:) let the tracker be computed from git; a post-merge hook and an hourly scheduled job render the three pages, publish them to Plane Pages via plane-docs.mjs, run plane:sync/triage and write a lag report; the SessionStart hook prints roadmap state and whether the artifacts are stale so any session on any account republishes with one call.

name: Inline returns and price adjustments on orders
description: Lets staff capture a return or a price adjustment directly on an existing order, instead of writing a separate credit note by hand.
notes: Web is merged. The shared return/price-adjustment math now lives once, in a new shared package, @routeflow/returns (#1262), imported by every consumer so there's no duplicate logic. The mobile operator screen is next -- its branch is ready but not yet pushed. The driver-facing screen is deferred: the owner declined to ship it behind a developer_mode flag -- see D-34.

name: At-location orders
description: Lets staff record an order taken at a customer's location, not just from the office.
notes: Specified. Owner's ruling: recording who received the delivery can be skipped -- it's logged when given, tenant-configurable, and off by default. Not started.

name: Credit notes you can see and control
description: Auto-apply off by default with a per-note exclude, void-with-reversal, and visibility of every credit (auto or manual) on an order and invoice, so a customer's credit balance is never a surprise.
notes: Epic #2400 (P0). R1.1a children: #2401 auto-apply off by default + per-note exclude + don't-re-apply memory; #2402 void with reversal (un-apply everywhere, release selections, reverse ledger); #2403 tenant-admin Remove-credit-on-invoice bug, MERGED; #2404 show every credit on the order (auto+manual) with Remove, and in the picker. R1.1b follow-on, split from #2405 per SA-442's schema ruling (CreditNote.orderId/returnId, no new audit table -- AuditLog rows with entityType CreditNote): #2417 API half (link credits to order/return, duplicate-credit WARNING never a refusal, applications endpoint, audit trail; tier 1, one additive migration, lands after #2401 so payment.autoApplied exists) and #2418 web+mobile half (applications list, corrected 'Applied to' labels, invoice credits list, duplicate warning, history timeline; tier 2).

name: Fewer taps at the stop (driver app)
description: Cuts a normal cash stop from 6+ taps and 3+ screens down to as few as 3, so a driver completes a routine delivery without fighting the app.
notes: Epic #2090. SA-441 (2026-09-27) SPEC RULING + slice order, master b61d2a8d: child 1 CLOSED (target already removed). S1 (S) = child 2: prefill the payment amount with the existing reconciledAmountDue estimate, display/prefill only, completion payload unchanged. S2 (M) = child 3: hub gains 'Complete & collect' straight to payment when every line has a served remaining (SA-367a's needsEntry review-screen rule stands), default plan 'deliver all remaining', Review is one tap back to short-pick. S3 (M) = child 4: one proof-of-delivery screen for photo+signature together, regulatedPodGate and the completion payload unchanged. S4 (L) = child 5: payment screen IS the sheet (route list -> stop -> Complete & collect -> Collect, 3 taps) -- LAST, droppable at the Oct 2 freeze since S1-S3 already reach <=4 taps. Done-when: a plain cash stop with nothing adjusted completes in 3 taps, device screenshots at 390 before/after, SA-367/B785/SA-404 pins intact. #1787/F-24 (at-location orders) is explicitly OUT of this epic -- stays its own R3 row. Tier 2 UI, no money-write changes.
